title: Cohomological dimension of an affine scheme of finite type over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The proposition bounds the cohomological dimension of an affine scheme of finite type over a field: cd(X) at most dim(X) + cd(K) (statement lines 19762-19766). The proof is an induction on the dimension whose hard part is the positive-dimensional case, and it contains two auxiliary arguments the author isolates as Interlude I and Interlude II: the first analyses an open immersion j : X -> Y of smooth d-dimensional varieties with complement the support of an effective Cartier divisor (proof lines 19798-19828), the second studies the loci of points of bounded transcendence degree in a smooth variety of dimension d-1 (proof lines 19831-19850). These feed the final commutative diagram involving the open immersion A^d_K -> P^1_K x_K A^{d-1}_K and the projection to A^{d-1}_K, which combines with the induction hypothesis and the curve case to give the bound (proof lines 19853-19913). The non-formal content is the reduction of the general case to the smooth situation together with the two interludes. The claim is H2: a long argument, entirely written out, with Noether normalization and the curve bound as its only inputs.
